tools.name: timetaag_list_employees
tools.description: List employees with their branch, department, designation, location and shift groups. Working employees by default; set status to resigned or all. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/employees.

tools.name: timetaag_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by employee code, with the same fields as the list. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/employees/{emp_code}.

tools.name: timetaag_list_leave_types
tools.description: List the leave types the company uses, for example annual or sick leave. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/leave-types.

tools.name: timetaag_list_leave_balances
tools.description: List the leave balances of one employee, per leave type. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/leave-balances.

tools.name: timetaag_list_leaves
tools.description: List leave entries that touch a date range, with status pending, approved or declined. Deleted leaves are left out. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/leaves.

tools.name: timetaag_get_leave
tools.description: Get one leave entry by its id. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/leaves/{id}.

tools.name: timetaag_list_daily_attendance
tools.description: List the calculated daily attendance (in, out, worked time, late and early marks) for a date range. Reports need a plan that includes them (HTTP 403 otherwise). Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/attendance/daily.

tools.name: timetaag_list_punches
tools.description: List the raw clock punches (biometric device and manual) for a date range. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/punches.

tools.name: timetaag_list_shift_assignments
tools.description: List which shift each employee works on each day in a date range. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/shift-assignments.

tools.name: timetaag_list_holidays
tools.description: List public holidays, for one year or one holiday group. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/holidays.

tools.name: timetaag_list_regularizations
tools.description: List attendance regularization requests (corrections of punches) in a date range, with their status. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/regularizations.

tools.name: timetaag_list_work_requests
tools.description: List work requests (for example on-duty or out-of-office) in a date range, with their type and status. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/work-requests.

tools.name: timetaag_list_expense_claims
tools.description: List expense claims in a date range, with their status and payout status. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/expense-claims.

tools.name: timetaag_list_setup
tools.description: List one kind of company setup: branches, departments, designations, locations, sections, teams, employment-types, biometric-groups, shifts, holiday-groups or devices. Use the ids in employee and leave filters. Timetaag API: GET /api/v2/<kind>.
